_comment: Labelled single-turn cases for src/agent/core-memory-routing.live.test.ts. `expect` is where the fact belongs under design/memory.md → Core Memory vs Hindsight: `core` = core_memory_update this turn; `hindsight` = retrievable on demand, never core memory; `none` = nothing worth storing. `inPassing` marks a core fact that comes up while the user asks for something else. `established` is the core memory the established state starts from; the empty state has no blocks, so the prompt shows the onboarding text instead. `state` limits a case to one state. In the established state, `keys` are the blocks a core write may target, `changes` match the established lines the case may rewrite or remove, and `drops` match lines no rewritten block may still hold.

Name: Samuel Carter
Role: backend engineer at Northwind Logistics
Location: London, UK (Europe/London)
Family: partner Alex; sister Jo
- Home server migration to NixOS (in progress)

cases.message: Quick update: I started at Monzo this week. I'm a staff engineer on the payments team now.
Can you call me Sam from now on? Nobody calls me Samuel.
cases.note: Name the agent addresses the user by.

cases.message: We've officially moved to Lisbon! Finally unpacked the last boxes.
cases.note: Location, and with it the timezone.

cases.message: I'm starting a side project called Tidepool, a tide-times app for sailors. I'll probably want your help with it over the next few months.
Always answer me in British English, please. The American spellings drive me mad.
cases.note: Standing preference on how to work with the user.

cases.message: Big news: Alex and I had a baby girl yesterday. Her name is Maya.
I've gone vegetarian, so keep that in mind whenever you suggest recipes or restaurants.
cases.note: Standing constraint that applies across conversations.

cases.message: I've moved to a four-day week, so Fridays are off now. Don't plan anything work-related for a Friday.
Can you draft a two-line intro for my new team? I'm joining Monzo's payments team as a staff engineer on Monday.
cases.note: Employer and role, mentioned in passing while asking for something else.

cases.message: What's a good day trip from Lisbon this weekend? We only moved here last month, so we're still exploring.
cases.note: Location, mentioned in passing while asking for something else.

cases.message: Suggest a quick dinner for tonight. Nothing with meat, I stopped eating it a while back.
cases.note: Standing constraint, mentioned in passing while asking for something else.

cases.message: The NixOS migration is finally done.
cases.note: An active project ends, so active_projects drops it.

cases.message: Had dinner at Taberna da Rua das Flores last night. The octopus was incredible.
My friend Priya just got a job at DeepMind, she's thrilled.
Jo's birthday is on 14 March, by the way.
cases.note: Detail about a family member: who Jo is belongs in core memory, her birthday is looked up when needed.

cases.message: For the quarterly report I've decided to go with a bar chart instead of the pie chart.
Finally fixed that flaky billing test. It was a timezone bug in the date parser.
I finished The Dispossessed last week. Loved the ending.
My landlord says the rent goes up to £2,100 a month from October.
I'm in Tokyo for a conference this week.
cases.note: A trip, not a move: home and timezone stay as they are.

cases.message: Alex got promoted to head of design.
Hey, how's it going?
What's the difference between a mutex and a semaphore?
Grabbing a coffee, back in ten.
What's 72°F in Celsius?

I'm feeling a bit tired today, didn't sleep well.
What's a good coffee-to-water ratio for pour-over?
